title: Azure Data Explorer

fields.name: alias
fields.description: Sets an alias, use to define multiple instances of the same output plugin.

fields.name: auth_type
fields.description: Set the authentication type: service_principal, managed_identity, or workload_identity. For managed_identity, use system as client_id for system-assigned identity, or specify the managed identity's client ID.

fields.name: azure_kusto_buffer_key
fields.description: When buffering is true, set the Azure Kusto buffer key which must be specified when using multiple instances of Azure Kusto output plugin and buffering is enabled.

fields.name: blob_uri_length
fields.description: Set the length of generated blob URI before ingesting to Kusto.

fields.name: buffer_dir
fields.description: When buffering is true, specifies the location of directory where the buffered data will be stored.

fields.name: buffer_file_delete_early
fields.description: When buffering is true, whether to delete the buffered file early after successful blob creation.

fields.name: buffering_enabled
fields.description: Enable buffering into disk before ingesting into Azure Kusto.

fields.name: client_id
fields.description: Required if managed_identity_client_id isn't set. The client ID of the AAD registered application.

fields.name: client_secret
fields.description: Set the client secret (Application Password) of the AAD application used for authentication.

fields.name: compression_enabled
fields.description: If enabled, sends compressed HTTP payload (gzip) to Kusto.

fields.name: database_name
fields.description: The database name.

fields.name: delete_on_max_upload_error
fields.description: When buffering is true, whether to delete the buffer file on maximum upload errors.

fields.name: host
fields.description: IP address or hostname of the target HTTP server.

fields.name: include_tag_key
fields.description: If enabled, a tag is appended to output. The key name is used tag_key property.

fields.name: include_time_key
fields.description: If enabled, a timestamp is appended to output. The key name is used time_key property.

fields.name: ingestion_endpoint
fields.description: The cluster's ingestion endpoint, usually in the form https://ingest-cluster_name.region.kusto.windows.net.

fields.name: ingestion_endpoint_connect_timeout
fields.description: The connection timeout of various Kusto endpoints in seconds.

fields.name: ingestion_mapping_reference
fields.description: The name of a JSON ingestion mapping that will be used to map the ingested payload into the table columns.

fields.name: ingestion_resources_refresh_interval
fields.description: Set the Azure Kusto ingestion resources refresh interval.

fields.name: io_timeout
fields.description: Configure the HTTP IO timeout for uploads.

fields.name: log_key
fields.description: Key name of the log content.

fields.name: log_level
fields.description: Specifies the log level for output plugin. If not set here, plugin uses global log level in service section.

fields.name: log_supress_interval
fields.description: Suppresses log messages from output plugin that appear similar within a specified time interval. 0 no suppression.

fields.name: match
fields.description: Set a tag pattern to match records that output should process. Exact matches or wildcards (for example *).

fields.name: match_regex
fields.description: Set a regular expression to match tags for output routing. This allows more flexible matching compared to wildcards.

fields.name: net.connect_timeout
fields.description: Set maximum time allowed to establish a connection, this time includes the TLS handshake.

fields.name: net.connect_timeout_log_error
fields.description: On connection timeout, specify if it should log an error. When disabled, the timeout is logged as a debug message.

fields.name: net.dns.mode
fields.description: Select the primary DNS connection type (TCP or UDP).

fields.name: net.dns.prefer_ipv4
fields.description: Select the primary DNS resolver type (LEGACY or ASYNC).

fields.name: net.dns.prefer_ipv6
fields.description: Prioritize IPv6 DNS results when trying to establish a connection.

fields.name: net.dns.resolver
fields.description: Select the primary DNS resolver type (LEGACY or ASYNC).

fields.name: net.io_timeout
fields.description: Set maximum time a connection can stay idle while assigned.

fields.name: net.keepalive
fields.description: Enable or disable Keepalive support.

fields.name: net.keepalive_idle_timeout
fields.description: Set maximum time allowed for an idle Keepalive connection..

fields.name: net.keepalive_max_recycle
fields.description: Set maximum number of times a keepalive connection can be used before it's retried.

fields.name: net.max_worker_connections
fields.description: Set the maximum number of active TCP connections that can be used per worker thread.

fields.name: net.proxy_env_ignore
fields.description: Ignore the environment variables HTTP_PROXY, HTTPS_PROXY and NO_PROXY when set.

fields.name: net.source_address
fields.description: Specify network address to bind for data traffic.

fields.name: net.tcp_keepalive
fields.description: Enable or disable Keepalive support.

fields.name: net.tcp_keepalive_interval
fields.description: Interval between TCP keepalive probes when no response is received on a keepidle probe.

fields.name: net.tcp_keepalive_probes
fields.description: Number of unacknowledged probes to consider a connection dead.

fields.name: net.tcp_keepalive_time
fields.description: Interval between the last data packet sent and the first TCP keepalive probe.

fields.name: port
fields.description: TCP port of the target HTTP server.

fields.name: retry_limit
fields.description: Set retry limit for output plugin when delivery fails. Integer, no_limits, false, or off to disable, or no_retries to disable retries entirely.

fields.name: scheduler_max_retries
fields.description: Optional. When buffering is On, set the maximum number of retries for ingestion using the scheduler.

fields.name: store_dir_limit_size
fields.description: When buffering is true, set the max size of the buffer directory.

fields.name: table_name
fields.description: The table name.

fields.name: tag_key
fields.description: The key name of tag. If include_tag_key is false, this property is ignored.

fields.name: tenant_id
fields.description: Required if managed_identity_client_id isn't set. The tenant/domain ID of the AAD registered application.

fields.name: time_key
fields.description: The key name of time. If include_time_key is false, this property is ignored.

fields.name: tls
fields.description: Enable or disable TLS/SSL support.

fields.name: tls.ca_file
fields.description: Absolute path to CA certificate file.

fields.name: tls.ca_path
fields.description: Absolute path to scan for certificate files.

fields.name: tls.ciphers
fields.description: Specify TLS ciphers up to TLSv1.2.

fields.name: tls.crt_file
fields.description: Absolute path to Certificate file.

fields.name: tls.debug
fields.description: Set TLS debug level. Accepts 0 (No debug), 1(Error), 2 (State change), 3 (Informational) and 4 (Verbose).

fields.name: tls.key_file
fields.description: Absolute path to private Key file.

fields.name: tls.key_passwd
fields.description: Optional password for tls.key_file file.

fields.name: tls.max_version
fields.description: Specify the maximum version of TLS.

fields.name: tls.min_version
fields.description: Specify the minimum version of TLS.

fields.name: tls.verify
fields.description: Force certificate validation.

fields.name: tls.verify_hostname
fields.description: Enable or disable to verify hostname.

fields.name: tls.vhost
fields.description: Hostname to be used for TLS SNI extension.

fields.name: tls.windows.certstore_name
fields.description: Sets the certstore name on an output (Windows).

fields.name: tls.windows.use_enterprise_store
fields.description: Sets whether using enterprise certificate store or not on an output (Windows).

fields.name: unify_tag
fields.description: This creates a single buffer file when the buffering mode is true.

fields.name: upload_file_size
fields.description: Specifies the size of files to be uploaded in megabytes.

fields.name: upload_timeout
fields.description: Optionally specify a timeout for uploads. Fluent Bit will start ingesting buffer files which have been created more than x minutes and haven't reached upload_file_size limit yet.

fields.name: workload_identity_token_file
fields.description: Set the token path for workload identity authentication.

description: Fluent Bit output plugin: Azure Data Explorer.
